# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `evermind` MCP server pointing at EverMe's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api.everme.evermind.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with EverMe user login — no API key to configure.
- Logo: the EverMe mark from the `EverMind-AI/EverMe` GitHub repository.
